This is a very heavy and heavy duty product. The pieces all fit together well. The one exception is that the rubber foot piece meant for counter protection doesn’t stay on well on its own. It relies on the counter itself to hold it in place. The handle rotates easily. There isn’t any adjustability, as far as I can tell, in terms of grain size. I would pay very close attention to what the countertop looks like where I intend to mount this, because it will absolutely not work with all countertops. You need a decently large lip extending off from from your cabinet/drawer faces, and my kitchen doesn’t come with any that would work. I have a butcher block island that I can mount it too eventually, but even your islands must have an overhang in order for this to work. The red piece didn’t have instructions with regard to where to put it, but I was able to figure it out without difficulty. It feels like a product that will last a long time.

We run a small farm and often need to replace old fence posts. After comparing several similar tools, we chose this post puller and it has exceeded our expectations. It works reliably on all our fence posts and sign posts, performing well even when the posts are firmly set in hard soil. The build quality is solid, and the price is reasonable for a heavy-duty tool. It has boosted our work efficiency a lot over the past months.
